notes: The San Francisco Call's daily Building Contracts list for the whole of 1907: every issue in curiv_hercules_ver01, curiv_indio_ver01 and curiv_mecca_ver01 (7,417 OCR pages). Located on the 1908 shapes - the list's heading, the entry's shape ('with CONTRACTOR - WORK ... line/corner of ...; $AMOUNT'), a 'with' followed by a dash and a work word - and two more 1907 needed: a storey count with a 'line of'/'corner of' within 200 characters, and a fuzzy location word (OCR 'Une', 'llne', 'comer'); 567 page-blocks on 317 days. Every one of the 2,523 candidate segments was read by hand by one reader, on the 1908 spec; 50 entries the OCR ran into the entry before (their 'with' read as 'vtfth', 'wia', '-rlth') were read as entries of their own. Private owners, estates and trustees are cut from raw and extra: the quote starts at 'with' and ends at the entry's own amount, is trimmed after its last figure where what follows reads as a name, and 45 quotes were started or ended by hand where the amount had no figure in it or a news column followed; every tail was scanned for a capitalised name. Institutional and company owners are kept in extra.owner_firm, a named building in extra.building_name, and three notable past owners in extra.notable_owner (Claus Spreckels, David Hewes, and James D. and Mary L. Phelan). A contractor's name garbled past repair, or read only as a guess, is printed as 'a builder'. 1907's OCR reads a capital N as X; the lettered avenues are read as their present names (A Anza, B Balboa, C Cabrillo, D Fulton, H Lincoln Way, I Irving, J Judah, K Kirkham, L Lawton, M Moraga, N Noriega, P Pacheco, T Taraval); First avenue is Arguello, Dupont Grant, Point Lobos Geary, Montgomery avenue Columbus, Army Cesar Chavez, Union Square avenue Maiden Lane, Kentucky and Railroad avenue Third Street, Devisadero Divisadero. Placed with corner.py --batch --json, a lot pass, an offset pass and a corner pass: a single parcel matching the record's lot within 4% (its offset within 4 ft where printed) or its offset within 4 ft (its lot within 10% where printed), the roll year within two years of 1907 - an alteration a building standing by 1906, through built_by - the side or quadrant the record names, a storey count not off by 1.5 or more, and a corner with no lot or offset only on the one corner lot within 90 ft of the crossing; a corner record that prints a lot that cannot be measured also needs its storeys to agree exactly. Named buildings placed by name where the page carries the name in its own record: the Palace Hotel, the Phelan, Hewes, Postal Telegraph, Flood, Adam Grant and Central Realty buildings, the Hibernia Bank, the Bank of California, the Humboldt Bank, La Granada and St. Francis hotels, the Claus Spreckels building and its annex, Mary's Help Hospital and the Alaska Commercial building. The Union Trust building is left unresolved: the 1908 batch placed it on 1 Montgomery Street, whose page records a different building. Only 42 entries print a street number; resolve_eas refuses or cannot find all 30 it was asked about. One parcel is one page, and one entry per building: the general contract, else the earliest, carries the page's entry.

coverage.remaining: Nothing of the 1907 daily lists is known to remain unread: all issues the three batches hold were scanned, 567 page-blocks on 317 days located and read whole. Days without a block are Mondays and holidays the list did not run, and days whose OCR lost every shape (several in late 1907, when the list shrank to an entry or two under a broad real-estate heading); those were not hand-searched. Of the 1,659 unresolved, 508 have no parcel matching the lot or offset with a roll year near 1907 (the building replaced, or the lot re-cut), 459 single candidates were refused (side, roll year, storeys, offset, not the corner lot), 53 match several parcels, 156 are on a street that is a guess at garbled print, that EAS no longer holds, or that does not meet the cross street, 444 could not be measured (no cross street, no quadrant, an illegible offset or direction, a tract lot, a named building no page carries), 28 print a number the renumbering guard refuses or EAS does not know, and 11 sit on a parcel re-lotted as condominiums since.
coverage.note: 7,417 OCR pages scanned (every page of 1907 in curiv_hercules_ver01, curiv_indio_ver01 and curiv_mecca_ver01); 567 page-blocks kept; 2,523 candidate segments read, 616 of them not entries (281 advertisements, 275 news paragraphs, 32 fragments, 28 market reports), 1,907 contract entries read and 50 run-on entries inside them - 1,957 findings (1,855 building contracts, 102 alterations). 298 resolved by hand - 274 by lot, offset and corner with corner.py's geometry, 24 on a building the record names - and 1,659 unresolved, each with its reason. 242 published on 242 pages, 118 of them seeded; 56 declined, 55 further contracts for a building whose entry already carries one and 1 contradicting a 1908 contract already on the page.
